# HR Competition & Differentiation

| Competitive layer | Representative direction | Industry implication |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Global HCM suites | Workday and SAP SuccessFactors combine broad HR coverage with embedded AI. | Avoid a full-suite feature-count contest; lead with selected operating workflows. |
| Regional HCM platforms | Local vendors compete on payroll, labour rules and domestic delivery. | Country rules, implementation proof and integration quality matter. |
| Point solutions | Recruitment, attendance, payroll and scheduling tools solve individual steps. | An employee-master and attendance-to-payroll chain can reduce duplicate entry. |
| Industry capability | Industry templates + local rule engine + auditable AI + cross-border deployment. | Governance, operational closure and implementation evidence increasingly shape selection. |
